bestBets.overview: BOY CRUSH is a talented type who attacks this first up with the benefit of a nice trial effort. In his first preparation he was an impressive debut winner then was narrowly edged out at his second start behind a very talented type. If he's within striking distance on straightening he'll be hard to hold out. DAWN DANCER is a very speedy and tough filly. On the seven-day back-up after beating the older horses last Saturday, she can win again. RUN RUPERT RUN attacks this first up off a very impressive trial win. RUTHLESS ANGEL next best.

raceTips.comment: Dawn Dancer should go close to winning again? She’s won three in a line and was able to step into 66+ company against the older horses last Saturday and win with a leg in the air. Back to her own age group, drawn to lead again, great use of the claim, should get conditions to suit and is just a little flying machine! Boy Crush resumes and trialled well for his return, brings high quality 2YO form from last prep to the table. Run Rupert Run trialled enormous? Settled last and descended upon them late, may have come back a much more mature & furnished horse this time in. Farnova is your map horse but probably lacks the quality of a couple of these but the camp is deadset airborne.

bestBets.overview: RISSOLES is a talented mare who resumes without a trial but usually races well fresh. Although this is short of her pet distance, I'm  expecting her to be hard to hold out. HAIDA GWAII has built up an impressive strike rate. Although she's up in grade I expect her to measure up. PIN DEEP is rock-hard fit and racing well. SEPTEMBER BORN is very talented when right. If he brings his best form he goes very close.

raceTips.comment: Haida Gwaii is just a ripper 1000m mare who has also had her own issues to work through throughout her racing career. She’s quick, she’s versatile and she can seriously run time over the flying 1000m, if she’s fully wound up she’ll be very hard to beat, especially with a map to work with. Hopeful we can see September Born’s class come to the fore here despite the fact he might find the 1000m on the short side. Loved his trial, it’s been well documented he’s had many issues hamper his racing career but Neville Parnham has also been happy to document this is the soundest he’s had him leaving into a campaign of racing and the small field should really suit him. Best horse in the race, not his distance, but his ability & class should take him a long way. 1000m horses win 1000m races! Pin Deep had excuses last start and was a dominant winner prior, he’s flying in the new colours. Rissoles will find the 1000m short and the map’s not in her favour but she’s got a ripping turn of foot and she’s perennially underrated by the market.

bestBets.overview: ETERNAL WINE is bursting to win a race. She's on the seven-day back-up after a fast-finishing effort here last Saturday, and if she's close up enough on straightening she'll be hard to hold out. KINGS HONOUR was a strong on-speed winner here last Saturday. He rolls forward and gives a big kick. TOO DARN STORMY has been a costly horse for the punters for a number of starts now but he will be around the mark again. DIAMOND DANCER has ability and attacks this first up off a nice trial win.

raceTips.comment: Eternal Wine really deserves to win one. Ran 2nd at each of her last 3 outings, backs up from last week and while she’ll likely get back in the second half here from the draw, there’s really strong speed engaged and she should get her chance once again to gun them down late if good enough. Kings Honour bounced back to his best 7 days ago for a flying MJ Pateman yard and can park right over the speed here with a map advantage on his rivals which could prove telling. Too Darn Stormy was no match for Eternal Wine first up but still ran well with a hampered passage in the straight, just a tough draw here to have to navigate. Diamond Dancer has been off the scene for a long while but has trialled for her return like she’s ready to rock’n’roll and she maps super.

bestBets.overview: HURRICANE HARLEY attacks this off an impressive first-up win in midweek company. This is a rise in class but he's a horse on the rise and I'm expecting him to measure up. HUBBLE'S DRAGON was a big eye-catcher first up but raced well below his best second up, parking on the speed and giving little. Back down in the weights and ridden more quietly I expect him to improve sharply. SPLIT THE GEE has ability and resumes with the benefit of a sharp trial win. SWANSEE is flying and has claims despite the rise in class.

raceTips.comment: Thinking Hurricane Harley can take the leap. Win midweek off a freshen was remarkably good and he’s always shown above average ability. Looks ready to put it all together now and Austin Galati seems to just click with him given he does certainly have a few tricks. Versatile and very talented despite the rise in class. Prospector’s Pick’s best would win this, just not convinced he’s come back? Trials iffy and so was the first up run but he’s out of comfortably the strongest form reference for this, tactics from the gate will be interesting. Country God has trialled well for his return and can win, maps a treat from the gate. Hubble’s Dragon ran a cracker first up and then made the bold call of going toe to toe with Lord Shiva up on speed last start, lesson learnt! Can bounce back without surprise. One of the more open races of the day.

bestBets.overview: DIRTY HABITS is a lightly raced but very talented type. He will be better suited over further and attacks this off a seven-week let-up but I still think he'll give it is a big shake on raw ability alone. GOD'S GATE is flying this time in but has been chopped down late in his last two starts. From gate one he can lead or park in the box seat and in either scenario he goes close. GOD'S CROSS is an emerging type who produced an impressive fast-finishing win resuming from a spell at Bunbury. He should get every chance from gate four and run well. GET OUT MICK is performing well without winning.

raceTips.comment: God’s Gate has really turned a corner since the ultimate gear change. He’s racing genuinely, he’s more tractable, he’s on speed and he’s been really strong late in his races. Rolls forward again here out of a very high rating 2nd last start behind Bosun and think if he can kick through and lead something will need to be good to beat him. God’s Cross is a nice animal. Weaker race but won well on return and more than held his own in Saturday 3YO company last prep. Drawn well, improves second up and gets some weight relief, looks the danger. Dirty Habits will be at his best over further than 1300m but he’s a Saturday winner in waiting, off a freshen may not be fully wound. Main Act is going as well as he could be and like the booking of Brad Parnham.

bestBets.overview: SILENT DIVA is bursting to win a race. She bumped into a smart one three starts ago, was luckless the start after then last start got going late to run a strong second to a subsequent winner. She should get every chance from a good draw and she gives the impression the rise to 1400m will suit. COSMIC WALTZ was game in defeat last Saturday behind a very talented type. He will park on the speed and give a big kick. ZEEZEA attacks this off back-to-back strong midweek wins. BELAURA STAR next best.

raceTips.comment: Thought this was probably a two horse race. Silent Diva looks ready to win. Thought she was going to drop out the way she was travelling last start at the 600m but picked herself up to motor late and reel off the quickest L200m sectional (quite comfortably too) of the entire meeting behind Lord Shiva who franked that form by walloping them again on the back-up last Saturday. The way she finished off 1400m is what she’s looking for, she’s drawn beautifully and CJP suits her really well. Deserving favourite. Cosmic Waltz the danger and has a great map to work with as well. Very good to stick on into 2nd behind a mare trending like she’s going to be black-type in Cinque Stelle last start. He is back to 1400m but he’s got tactical speed and he’ll be in front of the favourite on straightening, the one for mine she’ll need to get to. Allentown could find the top here and run a cheeky race if doing so but 1400m the query? Belaura Star next.

bestBets.overview: THE CRIMSON PIRATE was narrowly edged out over 1400m first up. He improves off that run, will appreciate the rise to 1600m and draws to get every chance in running. YES I KNOW ran well in the same race. The only query for him is where he lands in running from his wide draw. STATEWIDE knocked off a smart type last start. If he repeats that effort he can win again. SUPERNATURAL is rock-hard fit and racing well.

raceTips.comment: The Crimson Pirate looks one of the better bets on the program in the last. Loved his return at 1400m in this company when 2nd to Charino, he gets Lucy Fiore back in the chair and he was a black-type winner over a mile last prep as a 3YO in the Lex Piper. Think he’s the best horse in the race, he maps perfectly from the draw and should really be going extremely close in this, very nice animal. Yes I Know was a little wayward in the straight last start but gets CJP back on and riding 54kgs which catches the eye, off his runs over East the mile should suit him down the ground given he’ll get back and be winding up late. Exceltrain is just an honest, tough, on speed campaigner, always tough to get past especially when left alone which he very could well be here. Statewide won well last start and finally delivered on some promise that he’s always touted from earlier in his career.
